# To

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Loops](Language-Features-Loops)

</div>


```blitzbasic
For variable = from To limit
```

## Description

Separates the start and the limit of a [For](For) loop. The limit is included.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
For i = 2 To 4
	Print i
Next
```

```text
2
3
4
```
